headline: Honda Executive Warns Higher Tariffs on Canadian Imports 'Catastrophic'
summary: A Honda executive warned that prospective increases in US import tariffs on goods from Canada would have catastrophic consequences for integrated automotive manufacturing.
why: Major automakers maintain deeply integrated cross-border supply chains connecting Ontario assembly facilities with US component suppliers and dealers.

impacts.name: Automotive
impacts.why: Tariffs disrupt seamless North American component supply chains and sharply increase unit assembly costs.
